plan.selection: Maximum clean/noisy mean macro-F1, clean accuracy no worse than reference by 0.005; minimum mean gain 0.005
plan.confirmation: One selected candidate refit on fit+selection; mean macro-F1 gain >=0.01, nonnegative clean F1 gain, accuracy and typo F1 drops <=0.005
plan.validation: Selected candidate refit on full training; same fixed confirmation criteria against saved baseline on existing validation
plan.test_release: Only after validation passes: one benchmark evaluation; positive clean F1 gain, accuracy/typo F1 drops <=0.005 and paired normalized-template bootstrap lower bound >0
plan.limits: Repeatedly explored development corpus; split fingerprints control normalized equality, not all paraphrases; existing test is not fresh independent evidence
plan.nb_variant: Balanced one-versus-rest SVM on binary word/bigram NB ratios; C=1; no NB/SVM interpolation
plan.class_weights: Balanced exponent 1 versus normalized square-root exponent 0.5; reference alpha 1e-5 versus fixed 3e-6 alternative
